subject: keycap-cluster
notes: GMK CYL OG Extensions is a bottom-row/spacebar replacement kit for existing GMK CYL colorways, not a full alpha set — cluster deliberately omits alphas and centers on a wide focal spacebar flanked by four 1.25u modifier caps. Terracotta splash + bronze accent match the sibling article's own hero art (apps/web/public/hero-art/gmk-cyl-og-extensions-interest-check.svg) for cross-piece consistency.
source: plan/bearings.md § Group-buy hero art — colorful SVGs
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of subject
composition: Four Cherry-profile modifier caps (1.25u each) framing one wide focal spacebar (~6.25u): back row — two smaller modifiers set back (Ctrl-analog left, Alt-analog right), implying the rest of the bottom row without drawing it in full; front row — a modifier left (Win/GUI-analog), the focal spacebar center, a modifier right (Fn-analog). The composition intentionally excludes any alpha keycaps to signal 'extension kit, not full set' at a glance. Focal spacebar carries the terracotta splash fill across body, inset dish, and front lip, with a long gentle dashed row-sculpt centerline spanning its full width. Bronze theme dot (upper-right) and terracotta accent pip (lower-right) provide the two color anchors per the single-splash convention, positioned to echo the sibling gmk-cyl-og-extensions-interest-check.svg hero art's palette.
